models.name: erp_hrm_guests

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account expires. Used for automatic cleanup of stale guest accounts.

models.name: erp_hrm_guest_sessions
models.description: Temporary session tokens for guest access to pre-authentication features. Guest sessions allow unauthenticated visitors to interact with the system before registration. Each session tracks connection metadata (IP, referrer) and has an expiration for security. Sessions are append-only audit records of guest access.

foreignFields.name: guest_id

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address at session creation.

plainFields.name: href

plainFields.name: referrer

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: expired_at

models.name: erp_hrm_members
models.description: Global member identity representing registered users with email/password credentials. This is the canonical identity record that spans across all organizations - a single user account can belong to multiple organizations via {@link erp_hrm_organization_members}. Contains authentication credentials and profile information.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for authentication and communication. Must be valid email format.

plainFields.name: password_hash

plainFields.name: first_name
plainFields.description: Member's first name for profile display.

plainFields.name: last_name

plainFields.name: avatar_url

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: Member's preferred timezone for displaying dates and times. Defaults to organization timezone if not set.

plainFields.name: locale

plainFields.name: email_verified_at

models.name: erp_hrm_member_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for authenticated member sessions. Tracks active login sessions with access tokens, refresh tokens, and connection metadata (IP, referrer). Each session belongs to a member and expires after a defined period for security. Sessions are append-only audit records of member authentication events.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link erp_hrm_members.id}.

plainFields.name: access_token

plainFields.name: referrer

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Used for security to limit session lifetime.

models.name: erp_hrm_member_password_resets
models.description:
Temporary password reset tokens for member account recovery.

Each record represents a single password reset request initiated by a member. The system generates a unique token that is delivered to the member's registered email address. The token has a limited validity period defined by expires_at. Once used successfully, the consumed_at timestamp is set to prevent replay attacks.

Password reset tokens are single-use and expire automatically after a configured time period (typically 24 hours). Members can request multiple reset tokens, but only the most recent unexpired token is valid for use. This table maintains an audit trail of all password reset attempts for security monitoring purposes.

{@link erp_hrm_members}

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link erp_hrm_members.id}. The member who requested the password reset.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique cryptographically secure random token sent to the member's email for password reset verification. Must be unpredictable and single-use.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token becomes invalid. Tokens past this datetime cannot be used for password reset regardless of consumption status.

plainFields.name: consumed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully used to reset the password. Once consumed, the token is permanently invalidated to prevent replay attacks. Null if not yet consumed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset was requested and this record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record. Typically set when the token is consumed.

models.name: erp_hrm_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for member registration confirmation.

Stores verification tokens sent to users during the registration process to confirm ownership of their email address. Each token is time-limited for security purposes and becomes invalid after expiration or upon successful verification.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member account awaiting email verification. {@link erp_hrm_members.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Cryptographically secure verification token sent to the user's email address. Must be unique and unpredictable.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: The email address being verified. Stored to ensure the verified email matches the token recipient.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token becomes invalid. Tokens are typically valid for a limited time (e.g., 24 hours) for security.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null until verification is completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was last modified.

models.name: erp_hrm_organizations
models.description:
Root tenant entity representing companies/organizations in the erpHrm system.

This table serves as the aggregate root for all organization-scoped data isolation. Each organization contains identity information (name, description, logo) and configuration settings (currency, timezone, fiscal calendar) that define how the organization operates within the system.

Organizations are owned by a User (referenced via owner_id) who has administrative control. All other domain entities (members, roles, departments, projects, tasks, etc.) belong to an organization and are isolated from other organizations.

Soft deletion is supported via deleted_at to allow for data recovery and maintain referential integrity with historical records.

foreignFields.name: owner_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user's {@link erp_hrm_members.id}. The user who created and owns this organization.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization name. Display name for the company/organization.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional organization description. Brief summary of the organization's purpose or business.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: Optional URL to the organization's logo image.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Default currency for the organization in ISO 4217 format (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW). Used for financial calculations and reporting.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: Organization's default timezone in IANA format (e.g., America/New_York, Asia/Seoul). Used for datetime localization.

plainFields.name: fiscal_year_start_month
plainFields.description: Month when the fiscal year starts (1-12). Used for financial reporting and analytics.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if active, set when organization is deleted.

models.name: erp_hrm_organization_members
models.description:
Employee records linking global users to specific organizations. Each record represents a membership that connects a user account to an organizational context, enabling the user to perform work within that organization. Contains role assignment for access control, optional department placement for organizational structure, position/title for hierarchy identification, employment type classification, and activation status for lifecycle management. Serves as the bridge entity that makes all work data (timelogs, timesheets, project assignments) organization-scoped.

Key business relationships:
- Belongs to {@link erp_hrm_organizations} via organization_id
- Links to global {@link erp_hrm_members} via user_id
- Assigned {@link erp_hrm_roles} for permissions
- Optionally belongs to {@link erp_hrm_departments}
- Has many {@link erp_hrm_contracts}, {@link erp_hrm_project_members}, {@link erp_hrm_timelogs}, {@link erp_hrm_timesheets}, {@link erp_hrm_timers}

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization's {@link erp_hrm_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Linked global user's {@link erp_hrm_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: role_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned role's {@link erp_hrm_roles.id} determining permissions.

foreignFields.name: department_id
foreignFields.description: Optional department assignment's {@link erp_hrm_departments.id}.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Optional job title or position within the organization (e.g., 'Senior Developer', 'Project Manager').

plainFields.name: employment_type
plainFields.description: Classification of working relationship: 'full_time', 'part_time', 'contractor', or 'intern'.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Activation status indicating whether the member can perform work activities. true=active, false=deactivated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the membership was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last membership update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for preserving historical work records.

models.name: erp_hrm_roles
models.description: Permission sets defined within an organization. Includes built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) and custom roles with configurable permissions. Assigned to organization members to control access rights. Each role belongs to exactly one organization and role names must be unique within that organization.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the role's purpose and responsibilities.

plainFields.name: is_builtin
plainFields.description: Whether this is a system-defined built-in role (Owner, Manager, Employee) or a custom user-defined role.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if role is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_departments
models.description:
Organizational hierarchy structure representing functional divisions or departments within a company.

Departments provide the organizational structure needed to categorize employees and reflect the company's internal hierarchy. Each department belongs to exactly one organization and can optionally have a parent department, supporting single-level parent-child nesting for department trees.

Departments are used for employee classification, organizational reporting, and filtering employee lists. Employees may be optionally assigned to a single department within their organization, reflecting their placement within the organizational structure.

The department hierarchy enables organizational chart visualization and department-based grouping for management and reporting purposes.

plainFields.name: description

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

foreignFields.name: organization_member_id

models.name: erp_hrm_projects
models.description:
Work initiatives within an organization that serve as containers for tasks and time tracking.

Projects represent organizational work efforts with defined scope, timelines, and team assignments. Each project belongs to a single organization and can have multiple members assigned through {@link erp_hrm_project_members}. Projects contain tasks ({@link erp_hrm_tasks}) and accumulate time entries ({@link erp_hrm_timelogs}) from assigned members.

Projects progress through a lifecycle status: active (receiving new work), archived (temporarily inactive), and completed (finished). Only active projects can receive new timelogs. Archived projects may be reactivated, while completed projects represent final closure.

Planning attributes include budget hours for capacity planning and optional start/end dates for scheduling. The color code provides visual identification in user interfaces.

foreignFields.name: organization_id

plainFields.name: name

plainFields.name: color_code

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of project scope and objectives.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status: active, archived, or completed.

plainFields.name: budget_hours
plainFields.description: Planned budget hours for capacity planning.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Scheduled project start date.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Scheduled project end date.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.description: Links organization members to projects with role designation, enabling project team composition. Each record represents an employee's assignment to a project with their specific role within that project context. Project member roles are independent of organization-level roles.

models.name: erp_hrm_tasks
models.description: Work items representing units of work within projects. Tasks support a status workflow (Open, In-Progress, Completed, Closed), priority classification (Low, Medium, High, Critical), assignment to organization members, and single-level parent-child hierarchy for basic work breakdown structures. Each task belongs to a {@link erp_hrm_projects} and can optionally reference a parent task for sub-task relationships. Task assignment is optional via {@link erp_hrm_organization_members}. Tasks serve as the primary work tracking entity that timelogs are recorded against.

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged project's {@link erp_hrm_projects.id}. The project this task belongs to.

foreignFields.name: assigned_to_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned member's {@link erp_hrm_organization_members.id}. The organization member responsible for completing this task. Null if unassigned.

foreignFields.name: parent_task_id
foreignFields.description: Parent task's {@link erp_hrm_tasks.id}. For sub-tasks, references the parent task. Limited to single-level nesting - child tasks cannot have their own children. Null for top-level tasks.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title or name. Brief summary of the work to be performed.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the task. May include requirements, acceptance criteria, or additional context.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the task. Allowed values: 'Open', 'In-Progress', 'Completed', 'Closed'. Open indicates ready to start, In-Progress indicates actively being worked, Completed indicates finished but not yet closed, Closed indicates archived or no longer active.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Priority level of the task. Allowed values: 'Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Critical'. Determines relative importance and urgency for work planning.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional deadline for task completion. When specified, indicates when the task should be finished.

plainFields.name: estimated_hours
plainFields.description: Optional estimated effort in hours required to complete the task. Used for planning and capacity management.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: erp_hrm_task_histories
models.description: Immutable audit trail recording status changes for tasks. Captures the complete history of task state transitions including previous and new status values, the user who performed the change, optional reason for the change, and precise timestamp. This append-only table ensures full accountability and compliance for task workflow tracking. References {@link erp_hrm_tasks} as the subject task and {@link erp_hrm_members} as the user who made the change.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_task_id

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_member_id

plainFields.description: Task status before the change occurred (e.g., 'open', 'in_progress', 'completed').

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: Task status after the change occurred (e.g., 'open', 'in_progress', 'completed').

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Optional explanation or reason for the status change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the status change was recorded.

models.name: erp_hrm_timelogs
models.description: Individual time entries recording work sessions performed by employees. Each timelog represents a discrete unit of tracked time with start and end timestamps, duration calculated in minutes, project and optional task associations, and billable status classification. Timelogs form the foundational data for time tracking, payroll calculations, and project cost analysis. They can be aggregated into weekly timesheets for approval workflows. Timelogs have lifecycle constraints based on timesheet association - those not included in approved timesheets remain editable by their creators or users with time management permissions, while approved timelogs are permanently locked for audit integrity.

foreignFields.name: organization_member_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who created this timelog. {@link erp_hrm_organization_members.id}

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Project this time was logged against. {@link erp_hrm_projects.id}

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task within the project that this time was logged against. {@link erp_hrm_tasks.id}

foreignFields.name: timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: Optional timesheet this timelog is included in. Null when timelog is independent. {@link erp_hrm_timesheets.id}

plainFields.name: start_time
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the work session began.

plainFields.name: end_time
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the work session ended.

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Duration of the work session in minutes, rounded to the nearest minute. Calculated from start_time and end_time.

plainFields.name: billable
plainFields.description: Whether this time entry is billable to clients or internal. True for billable hours chargeable to clients, false for non-billable internal work.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description documenting what work was performed during this time entry.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null if the timelog is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_timesheets
models.description:
Weekly collections of timelogs belonging to organization members with a complete approval workflow lifecycle. Timesheets aggregate all work hours recorded by an employee during a specific week, enabling structured review and approval processes.

The timesheet progresses through a status lifecycle: draft (initial collection of timelogs), submitted (awaiting review), approved (accepted and locked), or rejected (returned for correction). Once approved, all associated timelogs are locked to preserve the historical record.

Timesheets belong to a specific organization member and capture the week boundaries (start and end dates). When reviewed, the system records the reviewing organization member, review timestamp, and optional rejection reason to provide complete audit trail of the approval process.

{@link erp_hrm_organization_members} - The employee who owns this timesheet
{@link erp_hrm_organization_members} - The organization member who reviewed/approved the timesheet
{@link erp_hrm_timelogs} - Time entries included in this timesheet

foreignFields.name: organization_member_id
foreignFields.description: The organization member (employee) who owns this timesheet. {@link erp_hrm_organization_members.id}

foreignFields.name: reviewed_by_id
foreignFields.description: The organization member who reviewed and approved or rejected this timesheet. {@link erp_hrm_organization_members.id}

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the timesheet in the approval workflow. Values: 'draft' (collecting timelogs), 'submitted' (awaiting review), 'approved' (accepted and locked), 'rejected' (returned for correction).

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date of the week covered by this timesheet (inclusive). Typically Sunday or Monday based on organization settings.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: End date of the week covered by this timesheet (inclusive).

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was submitted for approval. Null while in draft status.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was reviewed (approved or rejected). Null until review occurs.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Explanation provided when a timesheet is rejected. Null for approved timesheets or when not yet reviewed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this timesheet record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if the timesheet is active, set when soft deleted for data retention.

models.name: erp_hrm_timers
models.description:
Active real-time tracking sessions for in-progress work that convert to timelogs when stopped.

Timers provide live time tracking capabilities, allowing employees to capture work duration as it occurs rather than estimating after completion. Each timer records the exact moment tracking began and associates the session with a project and optionally a specific task. When stopped, the timer automatically calculates the elapsed duration and creates a timelog entry containing the project, task, description, and calculated duration.

An employee can have at most one active timer at any moment. Timers persist indefinitely until explicitly stopped, accommodating various work patterns including long sessions. The timer serves as temporary state that gets converted to permanent timelog records upon completion.

foreignFields.name: organization_member_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who owns this timer. {@link erp_hrm_organization_members.id}

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Project being worked on during this timer session. {@link erp_hrm_projects.id}

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional specific task being worked on. {@link erp_hrm_tasks.id}

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Description of the work being performed during this timer session.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer began tracking. Used to calculate duration when converting to timelog.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

models.name: erp_hrm_activity_logs

models.name: erp_hrm_activity_log_details
models.description: Normalized key-value pairs storing detailed metadata for activity log entries. Supports flexible schema for different action types while maintaining 1NF compliance by decomposing variable action details into atomic key-value records rather than storing JSON.
